meta.title: Coffee Pause · My card
meta.description: The digital stamp card of Coffee Pause Cyprus.

card.remaining_one: {count} more coffee until your free one.
card.remaining_other: {count} more coffees until your free one.

complete.title: Your card is full!
complete.body: Your next coffee is on us.

coupon.title: Free coffee
coupon.subtitle: Any coffee you like, on the house.
coupon.showStaff: Show this code at the counter. Our staff will scan it.
coupon.usedNote: This coupon has already been redeemed. Thank you!
coupon.emptyBody_one: Collect {count} more stamp to earn a free coffee.
coupon.emptyBody_other: Collect {count} more stamps to earn a free coffee.

how.title: How it works
how.intro: Three simple steps. No app, no paper cards.

steps.title: Buy your coffee
steps.body: Order whatever you love: espresso, freddo, cappuccino.

steps.title: Get stamped
steps.body: Your barista taps your phone and the stamp lands instantly.

steps.title: Enjoy your free one
steps.body: At 10 stamps you get a coupon for a coffee on the house.

login.title: Sign in
login.intro: Enter your email and we'll send you a sign-in link. No password needed.
login.privacy: We only use your email for your stamp card.
login.signedOut: You're signed out. See you at your next coffee!

errors.invalid_email: That doesn't look like a valid email. Check it and try again.
errors.rate_limited: We've sent several links already. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.send_failed: We couldn't send the email. Try again in a moment.
errors.link_invalid: That link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one below.

checkEmail.title: Check your email
checkEmail.body: We sent a sign-in link to {email}. Open it on this phone to see your card.
checkEmail.bodyNoEmail: We sent a sign-in link to your email. Open it on this phone to see your card.
checkEmail.tipSpam: Can't find it? Check your spam folder.
checkEmail.tipExpiry: The link expires in 1 hour and works once.

logout.title: Sign out
logout.body: Sign out on this phone? Your stamps stay saved.

notAllowed.title: You don't have access here
notAllowed.body: This page is for cafe staff only. If you work here, ask the admin to give you access.

staff.title: Scan a coupon
staff.intro: Scan the customer's QR code. Your phone's own camera works too: the link opens here.
staff.scanning: Point at the QR code inside the frame…
staff.cameraDenied: Camera access was blocked. Allow it in the browser settings, or type the code.
staff.cameraUnsupported: This browser can't scan. Use the phone's camera, or type the code.
staff.notFound: No coupon with the code {code} at this cafe.

results.already_used: This coupon has already been used.
results.not_allowed: You're not allowed to redeem coupons.

admin.title: Admin
admin.placeholder: The admin dashboard comes in a later step.

stamp.cooldown_one: You were just stamped. You can get the next one in {count} minute.
stamp.cooldown_other: You were just stamped. You can get the next one in {count} minutes.

couponReady.title: You have a free coffee!
couponReady.body: Show your coupon at the counter whenever you like.
